references.text: Introduces the young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who later served in Micah's house
Explains how the Levite was hired as a priest in Micah's house
The Danites later visit Micah's house and speak with the Levite
Similar question 'What are you doing here?' asked to Hagar in the wilderness
Same question 'What are you doing here?' asked to the prophet Elijah at Horeb
Background of Micah's house and his shrine with an ephod and household gods
